description: This file is a Java class defining constants related to tenant configuration properties in the security module of Apache Fineract. It contains only static final String constants and a private constructor, serving as a constants holder.

classes.name: TenantConstants
classes.description: A final utility class containing static constant string values for tenant-related configuration property keys.
